acceptance_checks: A scalar mergegate.required_checks yields list(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_CHECKS) from shiki_config.configured_required_checks and from mergegate_check.configured_required_checks
The new regression fails on the pre-change scripts and passes after; red/green captured in the ledger
validate_shiki.config_required_checks() still raises ValidationError on the scalar shape; captured in the ledger
non_goals: Do not change .shiki/config.yaml or any workflow file.
Do not change any argv or CLI surface; tests/test_workflow_invocation.py stays untouched and green.
Do not change scripts/validate_shiki.py; it already rejects the shape loudly.
Do not touch tests/test_config_loading.py; PR #357 holds an active lock on it.
Do not change the load_shiki_config parser itself.
scope: In both copies of configured_required_checks (scripts/shiki_config.py and scripts/mergegate_check.py ~line 1785), treat a non-list raw mergegate.required_checks as absent and fall back to the documented default instead of iterating it. Add a regression to tests/test_required_checks_derivation.py pinning the scalar shape for both copies and binding the two copies to each other across the list/absent/empty/scalar shapes.
title: Guard configured_required_checks against a scalar mergegate.required_checks
